features.label: Worker independent of the browser
features.implemented_behavior: A standalone TypeScript process immediately runs a desk pass, then runs on EQUITY_INTERVAL_MS with a running guard; server pages read persisted state.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified

features.label: Child lifecycle and restart backoff
features.implemented_behavior: Supervisor launches one detached loop, restarts after exit with bounded exponential backoff, resets backoff after a calm interval and terminates the child process group on shutdown.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: The supervisor itself is an on-box process, not a host boot service.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: PID-owned heartbeat and stalled-loop recovery
features.implemented_behavior: Loop writes PID/timestamp before and after passes. Supervisor traces process ancestry, applies startup grace and restarts a stale or unowned child heartbeat.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: A heartbeat is not proof of a successful pass: finally writes it after failures too. Aster needs independent last-attempt, last-success and useful-progress status.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: Exchange-local session and calendar scheduling
features.implemented_behavior: Calendar uses America/New_York with NYSE weekends, holidays and early closes; session marks include morning passes and later completed-half-hour slots.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified

features.label: Durable attempt and success-only slot completion
features.implemented_behavior: Supervisor persists an attempt before running work and writes last-completed slot only after both watch and pass exit successfully.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified

features.label: Latest-due catch-up with bounded retries
features.implemented_behavior: pendingSlot selects the latest elapsed same-day session mark, keeps it pending until completion, delays a failed attempt until the next mark and applies mark cadence after the final slot. Later inbox entry says the fix is live.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: This is convergence through the latest due slot, not replay of every missed historical slot. It does not replay prior-day slots. The earlier Oct5 17:04 three-minute-window failure was superseded by the22:25 note and pinned source.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: Scheduled operational book check
features.implemented_behavior: Supervisor runs the audit during the preopen audit window, retries failure and writes a dated success stamp only for zero exit status; audit reports failures, notes and lock repair.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: Existing audit embeds inherited names and frozen strategy account ids; retain invariant-report machinery only. Missing uninitialized state is a note, not proof that an active funded book is healthy.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: Cross-process writer ownership
features.implemented_behavior: Equity book mutation acquires an exclusive create lock, writes owner PID, renews mtime, waits for contenders and removes the lock in finally.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: Source may steal any lock older than180s even if the holder is alive; use owner-fenced transactional leases in the new desk rather than copying that threshold behavior.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: Staged state and last-readable snapshot recovery
features.implemented_behavior: Writes next-state before appending ledger, keeps a last-readable previous state, atomically renames state and recovers a pending next-state only if its ledger head matches the ledger tail.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: JSON state, ledger, memory and journal are not one database transaction. A .prev fallback and ledger-tail check are limited recovery mechanisms, not complete replay reconciliation.
features.strategy_coupling: Preserve the operational contract with an empty strategy registry; import no strategy rules, seed holdings or capital defaults.

features.label: Ordered hash-linked operational ledger
features.implemented_behavior: Each pass record receives monotonic sequence and previous hash; stable sorted serialization is hashed and state stores the resulting ledger sequence/head.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned source; no live execution verified
limits: Hash linkage does not itself guarantee atomic state/event persistence or complete repair after interrupted appends.

noncopy_contract: No strategy modules, indicator/scanner outputs, stock selection, allocation rules, frozen playbooks or signal-derived proposals copied.
No inherited positions, seeded capital, symbols, book thresholds or strategy timing defaults copied.
Aster starts with an empty strategy registry and services only explicit operator instructions and approved existing paper orders.
External notifications/posting are capabilities only and require explicit destination authorization/configuration.
